mapper.select: SELECT id, balance_alert_enabled, balance_threshold, alert_interval_minutes, last_alert_at, updated_at FROM notification_settings WHERE id = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_settings ( id, balance_alert_enabled, balance_threshold, alert_interval_minutes, last_alert_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( 1, #{balanceAlertEnabled}, #{balanceThreshold}, #{alertIntervalMinutes}, #{lastAlertAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET balance_alert_enabled = EXCLUDED.balance_alert_enabled, balance_threshold = EXCLUDED.balance_threshold, alert_interval_minutes = EXCLUDED.alert_interval_minutes, last_alert_at = EXCLUDED.last_alert_at, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
